name: FindAndReplaceCellsInExcelWorksheet
label: Find and Replace in Excel Worksheet
description: Finds text and replaces it with another in the specified Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object where find and replace will be performed.

fields.name: SearchMode
fields.label: Search Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to perform a find operation or a find-and-replace operation.

selectOptions.label: Find and Replace
selectOptions.description: Locates and replaces text in the worksheet.

fields.name: TextToFind
fields.label: Text To Find
fields.description: The text or value to find in the worksheet.

fields.name: TextToReplaceWith
fields.label: Text To Replace With
fields.description: The text or value to replace the found text with (required if 'Search Mode' is 'Find and Replace').

fields.name: AllMatches
fields.label: All Matches
fields.description: If true, replaces all occurrences of the text. If false, replaces only the first occurrence.

fields.name: MatchCase
fields.label: Match Case
fields.description: If true, performs a case-sensitive search.

fields.name: MatchEntireCellContents
fields.label: Match Entire Cell Contents
fields.description: If true, matches only cells that contain exactly the specified text.

fields.name: SearchBy
fields.label: Search By
fields.description: Specifies whether to search by rows or columns.

fields.name: FoundCells
fields.label: Found Cells
fields.description: Returns a list of all matched cells when 'All Matches' is true.

fields.name: FoundColumnIndex
fields.label: Found Column Index
fields.description: Returns the column index of the found cell (if any).

fields.name: FoundRowIndex
fields.label: Found Row Index
fields.description: Returns the row index of the found cell (if any).
